label: Item Not Received

claim_types.not_received: Buyer says the item never arrived
claim_types.not_delivered_to_address: Buyer says nothing came to their address
claim_types.tracking_wrong: Buyer says the tracking status is wrong or fake
claim_types.no_response: Buyer says the seller ignored them
claim_types.delayed: Buyer complains about how long it has taken
claim_types.carrier_problem: Buyer says the carrier reported a problem (exception, returned, lost)

checklist.label: Delivery address matches the PayPal shipping address
Proof of delivery signature or delivery photo
Buyer messages after the delivery date

the delivery address on the tracking record
chat messages from the buyer after delivery
